footer.tagline: Malaysia's iconic satay brand — reborn for a global table.
footer.owner: Brand & secret recipe owned by YM Ungku Mohammed Fadli Bin Ungku Jalil. Exclusively promoted by Dato' Seri Farid Ibrahim (NNF Global).
footer.inspired: Inspired by Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad

hero.title: Malaysia's iconic satay, reborn.
hero.sub: A national heritage brand returns — built on a central kitchen, a versatile franchise model, and global ambition.

pillars.title: A proven concept, engineered to scale
pillars.c1Body: A standardized production hub supplying every outlet with consistent, frozen-ready satay — every stick tastes the same.
pillars.c2Body: Food truck, kiosk, and full-outlet formats enable rapid, low-cost expansion across any location and footfall.
pillars.c3Body: Localized identities in Arabic, Mandarin, Hindi, Japanese and more — ready for cross-border deployment.

heritage.title: A name Malaysians already trust
heritage.body: Saté Ria carries national recognition and a proprietary recipe held by its brand owner. Now it returns with a structured plan to reclaim market leadership — and take Malaysian satay to the world.
heritage.p1: Wholly-owned brand & secret recipe with full IP control
heritage.p2: Proven at high-footfall events including the F1 Grand Prix, Sepang
heritage.p3: Deployed across food truck, kiosk, and food-court formats

formats.title: One brand, three ways to enter
formats.t1d: Mobile unit for events, festivals, and high-traffic roadside zones. Low fixed cost, high visibility.
formats.t2d: Compact format for food courts, petrol stations, and transit hubs. Drive-thru variant available.
formats.t3d: Flagship dine-in and drive-thru store with the full menu and hot-pack take-away.

cta.title: Join the Saté Ria revival
cta.body: Franchise opportunities across all formats, central-kitchen supply partnerships, and strategic investment for international expansion.

fr.title: Own a piece of a national icon
fr.sub: A central-kitchen supply model keeps quality consistent and outlet operations simple — so franchisees can focus on growth from day one.
fr.flowTitle: From raw material to your outlet
fr.why1: Consistent taste across every outlet — no marinating or prep on site
fr.why2: Frozen distribution extends shelf life and cuts franchisee waste
fr.why3: Scalable to national supply from a single certified facility
fr.gtmTitle: A phased path to going global
fr.p1a: Relaunch the central kitchen with an automated skewering & freezing line
fr.p1b: Deploy 10 pilot kiosks across Klang Valley, Penang, and Johor Bahru
fr.p1c: Launch the hot-pack take-away concept and online ordering (Grab, ShopeeFood)
fr.p2a: Expand to 50 locations nationwide across all three formats
fr.p2b: Secure certified halal & food-safety accreditation for export
fr.p2c: Partner with petrol stations and launch a corporate & events catering arm
fr.p3a: Open the first overseas kiosk in the Middle East (Arabic brand variant)
fr.p3b: Target ASEAN: Singapore, Brunei, Indonesia, and Thailand
fr.p3c: License localized models for Korea & Japan; frozen retail packs for GCC
fr.ctaBody: Tell us your preferred format and location. We'll share the franchise pack and the path to opening.

ab.title: The taste of Malaysia, since the embers first glowed
ab.sub: Saté Ria is more than a recipe. It's a national memory — and a brand built to carry that memory across borders.
ab.storyTitle: A proven concept, backed by national leadership
ab.storyBody: With a recipe perfected over decades and a presence proven at Malaysia's biggest stages, Saté Ria enters a structured revival to reclaim leadership at home and build a recognizable brand abroad.
ab.s1: National recognition with an unmistakable, signature taste
ab.s2: A modern central-kitchen model protecting that taste at scale
ab.s3: International ambition across the Middle East, ASEAN, and East Asia
ab.ownBody: The brand and secret recipe are wholly owned by the Brand Owner, who retains full intellectual-property rights and safeguards brand integrity globally.
ab.langBody: Localized identities in Arabic, Mandarin, Hindi, Russian, Japanese, German, and Korean — ready for cross-border deployment.
ab.quote: Every stick should taste the same — whether it's grilled in Kuala Lumpur, Dubai, or Tokyo.
ab.boName: YM Ungku Mohammed Fadli Bin Ungku Jalil
ab.promoterRole: Exclusive Promoter — appointed by the Brand Owner
ab.inspired: Inspired by Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad.

ab.ctaTitle: Be part of the next chapter
ab.ctaBody: Franchisees, supply partners, and strategic investors are all welcome as Saté Ria scales nationally and abroad.
